fields.connection: Only react to this OBS connection (type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot). Leave empty to react to all of them.

obs.talking.description: Runs when you start or stop talking, from the OBS volume meter of your microphone. Great for PNG-tuber style reactions.

fields.connection: Only react to this OBS connection (type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot). Leave empty to react to all of them.
fields.input: Your microphone, exactly as OBS shows it in the audio mixer, like "Mic/Aux". Leave empty to listen to every audio source.
fields.threshold: How loud counts as talking, in dB, like -30. Closer to 0 means you have to be louder. The OBS mixer shows the level.
fields.quietMs: How long it must stay quieter before talking counts as stopped, in milliseconds, like 300. Stops short pauses from flickering.
fields.state: Started runs when you start talking, Stopped when you stop, Any for both.

variables.obsConnection: The name of the OBS connection this came from
variables.inputName: The audio source that is talking
variables.talking: True when talking started, false when it stopped
variables.levelDb: How loud it was, in dB

variables.props.visible: True if the source is shown
variables.props.locked: True if the source is locked
variables.obsItemId: OBS's number for this source in the scene

obs.setSourceTransform.description: Moves, resizes, turns or crops a source in a scene. Only the boxes you fill in are changed.

fields.connection: Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS.
fields.scene: The scene the source is in.
fields.source: The source name exactly as OBS shows it.
fields.positionX: Distance from the left edge of the screen, in pixels. Leave empty to keep it as it is.
fields.positionY: Distance from the top edge of the screen, in pixels. Leave empty to keep it as it is.
fields.scaleX: Horizontal size. 1 is normal, 2 is twice as wide, 0.5 is half. Leave empty to keep it as it is.
fields.scaleY: Vertical size. 1 is normal, 2 is twice as tall, 0.5 is half. Leave empty to keep it as it is.
fields.rotation: How far to turn it, in degrees (0 to 360). Leave empty to keep it as it is.
fields.cropLeft: How many pixels to cut off the left side. Leave empty to keep it as it is.
fields.cropTop: How many pixels to cut off the top. Leave empty to keep it as it is.
fields.cropRight: How many pixels to cut off the right side. Leave empty to keep it as it is.
fields.cropBottom: How many pixels to cut off the bottom. Leave empty to keep it as it is.
fields.boundsWidth: Width of the box the source is fitted into, in pixels (only if the source uses a bounding box). Leave empty to keep it as it is.
fields.boundsHeight: Height of the box the source is fitted into, in pixels (only if the source uses a bounding box). Leave empty to keep it as it is.

fields.scene: The scene the source is in.
fields.source: The source name exactly as OBS shows it.
fields.axis: Horizontal mirrors left and right, Vertical turns it upside down.

obs.rotateSource.description: Turns a source by some degrees. Fun for spinning an image.

fields.connection: Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS.
fields.scene: The scene the source is in.
fields.source: The source name exactly as OBS shows it.
fields.degrees: How many degrees to turn, like 90 (a quarter turn) or 180 (half turn).
fields.relative: Tick to turn from where it is now. Untick to set the exact angle instead.

obs.setInputMute.description: Mutes or unmutes an audio source, like your microphone.

fields.connection: Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS.
fields.input: The audio source name exactly as OBS shows it, like "Mic/Aux".
fields.state: Mute silences it, Unmute turns the sound back on, Toggle flips it.

obs.setInputVolume.description: Changes the volume of an audio source.

fields.connection: Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS.
fields.input: The audio source name exactly as OBS shows it, like "Mic/Aux".
fields.mode: SetDb sets the volume in decibels, SetMultiplier sets it as a multiplier, AdjustDb makes it louder or quieter than now.
fields.value: The number to use. In decibels, 0 is full volume and -100 is silent (up to 26). As a multiplier, 1 is full volume and 0 is silent (up to 20).

obs.setAudioTrack.description: Turns one of the six OBS audio tracks on or off for a source. Useful to keep sounds out of your recording or stream.

fields.connection: Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS.
fields.input: The audio source name exactly as OBS shows it.
fields.state: Enable puts the source on that track, Disable takes it off, Toggle flips it.

obs.setText.description: Changes the words shown by a text source in OBS. Handy for "latest follower" or a chat message on screen.

fields.connection: Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS.
fields.input: The text source name exactly as OBS shows it.
fields.text: The words to show. You can use %variables% here.

obs.setBrowserUrl.description: Makes a browser source in OBS open a different web page.

fields.connection: Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS.
fields.input: The browser source name exactly as OBS shows it.
fields.url: The web address to open, like "https://example.com/alert".

obs.refreshBrowser.description: Reloads a browser source in OBS, like pressing refresh. Helps when an overlay got stuck.

fields.connection: Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS.
fields.input: The browser source name exactly as OBS shows it.

obs.setImageFile.description: Swaps the picture shown by an image source.

fields.connection: Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS.
fields.input: The image source name exactly as OBS shows it.
fields.file: The full path of the picture on the computer where OBS runs, like "C:\Pictures\happy.png".

obs.setMediaFile.description: Swaps the video or sound file played by a media source.

fields.connection: Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS.
fields.input: The media source name exactly as OBS shows it.
fields.file: The full path of the file on the computer where OBS runs, like "C:\Videos\intro.mp4".

obs.setColor.description: Changes the color of a color source in OBS.

fields.connection: Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS.
fields.input: The color source name exactly as OBS shows it.
fields.color: The color as a hex code like #FF0000 (red). Add two more digits at the front for see-through, like #80FF0000.

obs.setInputSettings.description: Changes any setting of a source by sending OBS the settings as text. For advanced users who know the setting names.

fields.connection: Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS.
fields.input: The source name exactly as OBS shows it.
fields.settings: The settings to change, written as a JSON object, like {"text":"Hello"}.
fields.overlay: Tick to only change the settings you list and keep the rest. Untick to replace all settings with only these.

obs.getInputSettings.description: Reads all the settings of a source and keeps them for later steps. For advanced users.

fields.connection: Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS.
fields.input: The source name exactly as OBS shows it.
fields.resultArgument: The name of the variable that will hold the answer, so later steps can use it as %name%. Leave empty to not keep it. It will hold the settings as text. The default is obsInputSettings.

variables.obsInputSettings: All settings of the source, as JSON text (or the name you chose above)

obs.mediaControl.description: Plays, pauses, stops or skips a media source.

fields.connection: Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS.
fields.input: The media source name exactly as OBS shows it.
fields.command: What to do. TogglePlayPause pauses it if it is playing and plays it if not. Restart starts from the beginning; Next and Previous skip in a playlist.

obs.mediaSeek.description: Jumps to a spot in a video or sound in a media source.

fields.connection: Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS.
fields.input: The media source name exactly as OBS shows it.
fields.mode: Absolute jumps to an exact time from the start. Offset moves forward or back from where it is now.
fields.milliseconds: How many milliseconds (1000 = one second). For Offset, use a minus number to go back, like -5000.

obs.setFilterState.description: Turns a filter (an effect on a source) on or off.

fields.connection: Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS.
fields.source: The source or scene the filter is on, exactly as OBS shows it.
fields.filter: The filter name exactly as OBS shows it, like "Color Correction".
fields.state: Enable turns it on, Disable turns it off, Toggle flips it.

obs.setRandomFilterState.description: Picks one random filter on a source or scene and turns it on, off or flips it. Fun for random effects.

fields.connection: Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS.
fields.source: The source or scene whose filters to pick from.
fields.state: What to do with the picked filter: Enable, Disable or Toggle.
fields.resultArgument: The name of the variable that will hold the answer, so later steps can use it as %name%. Leave empty to not keep it. It will hold the name of the filter. The default is obsFilterName.

variables.obsFilterName: The name of the filter that was picked (or the name you chose above)

obs.setAllFiltersState.description: Turns every filter on a source or scene on, or all off at once.

fields.connection: Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS.
fields.source: The source or scene whose filters to change, exactly as OBS shows it.
fields.state: Enable turns all filters on, Disable turns them all off.

obs.setFilterSettings.description: Changes the settings of one filter by sending OBS the settings as text. For advanced users who know the setting names.

fields.connection: Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS.
fields.source: The source or scene the filter is on.
fields.filter: The filter name exactly as OBS shows it.
fields.settings: The settings to change, written as a JSON object, like {"brightness":0.2}.
fields.overlay: Tick to only change the settings you list and keep the rest. Untick to replace all settings with only these.

obs.setTransition.description: Picks which transition (fade, stinger and so on) OBS uses when switching scenes.

fields.connection: Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS.
fields.transition: The transition name exactly as OBS shows it, like "Fade".

obs.setTransitionDuration.description: Sets how long OBS scene transitions take.

fields.connection: Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS.
fields.milliseconds: The length in milliseconds (1000 = one second). OBS keeps it between 50 and 20000.

obs.studioMode.description: Turns OBS studio mode (a preview screen before going live) on or off.

fields.connection: Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS.
fields.state: Enable turns it on, Disable turns it off, Toggle flips it.

obs.studioTransition.description: In studio mode, sends the preview scene live using the current transition. Does nothing useful if studio mode is off.

fields.connection: Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS.

obs.streaming.description: Starts or stops your stream in OBS.

fields.connection: Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS.
fields.mode: Start begins streaming, Stop ends it, Toggle does the opposite of what it is doing now.

obs.recording.description: Starts, stops or pauses your recording in OBS.

fields.connection: Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS.
fields.mode: Start, Stop or Toggle controls recording. Pause, Resume and TogglePause control a recording that is already running.

obs.replayBuffer.description: Starts or stops the OBS replay buffer, or saves the last moments as a clip.

fields.connection: Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS.
fields.mode: Start and Stop turn the buffer on or off, Toggle flips it, Save keeps the last few moments as a file.
fields.resultArgument: The name of the variable that will hold the answer, so later steps can use it as %name%. Leave empty to not keep it. When saving, it will hold the clip's file path. The default is obsReplayPath.

variables.obsReplayPath: The file path of the saved clip (or the name you chose above)

obs.virtualCam.description: Turns the OBS virtual camera on or off, so other apps can use your OBS picture as a webcam.

fields.connection: Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS.
fields.mode: Start turns it on, Stop turns it off, Toggle flips it.

obs.createRecordChapter.description: Adds a chapter marker to the recording you are making now. Needs OBS 30.2 or newer and the Hybrid MP4 recording format.

fields.connection: Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS.
fields.chapterName: The name of the chapter, like "Boss fight". Leave empty to let OBS name it.

variables.success: True if OBS added the chapter, false if it refused (for example when you are not recording)

obs.getOutputState.description: Checks whether the stream, recording, replay buffer or virtual camera is running and keeps the details for later steps.

fields.connection: Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS.
fields.output: Which one to check. Pick Other for an output you name yourself.
fields.outputName: Only used when Output is Other: the exact name of the output.

variables.obsOutputTimecode: How long it has been running, like 00:12:34
variables.obsOutputBytes: How much data it has sent or saved
variables.obsOutputState: All the details as JSON text

obs.screenshot.description: Saves a picture of a source or scene to a file on the OBS computer.

fields.connection: Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS.
fields.source: The source or scene to photograph, exactly as OBS shows it. Leave empty for the scene that is live now.
fields.file: Where to save it, as a full path on the OBS computer, like "C:\Pictures\shot.png". The ending (png, jpg, bmp or webp) picks the picture type.
fields.width: Picture width in pixels, 8 to 4096. Leave empty to keep the normal size.
fields.height: Picture height in pixels, 8 to 4096. Leave empty to keep the normal size.
fields.quality: Picture quality from 0 to 100. Use -1 to let OBS decide.
fields.resultArgument: The name of the variable that will hold the answer, so later steps can use it as %name%. Leave empty to not keep it. It will hold the file path. The default is obsScreenshotPath.

variables.obsScreenshotPath: The file path of the saved picture (or the name you chose above)

obs.setProfile.description: Switches OBS to another profile (a saved set of settings).

fields.connection: Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS.
fields.profile: The profile name exactly as OBS shows it.

obs.setSceneCollection.description: Switches OBS to another scene collection (a saved set of scenes).

fields.connection: Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS.
fields.sceneCollection: The scene collection name exactly as OBS shows it.

obs.triggerHotkey.description: Presses an OBS hotkey for you, by its internal name.

fields.connection: Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS.
fields.hotkey: The hotkey's internal OBS name, like "OBSBasic.StartStreaming". Advanced: look it up with the Send OBS command (advanced) step using GetHotkeyList.

obs.getStats.description: Reads how hard OBS is working (CPU, memory, frame rate, dropped frames) and keeps it for later steps.

fields.connection: Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS.

variables.obsCpuUsage: How much computer power OBS uses, in percent
variables.obsMemoryUsage: How much memory OBS uses, in megabytes
variables.obsActiveFps: Frames per second OBS is making
variables.obsStreamOutputCongestion: How crowded the stream connection is (0 to 1)

obs.getStatus.description: Checks what OBS is doing right now (streaming, recording and so on) and keeps it for later steps.

fields.connection: Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS.

variables.obsConnected: True if Cuebot is connected to OBS
variables.obsRecordingPaused: True if the recording is paused
variables.obsReplayBuffer: True if the replay buffer is on
variables.obsVirtualCam: True if the virtual camera is on
variables.obsStudioMode: True if studio mode is on

obs.rawRequest.description: Sends OBS one command of your own and keeps the answer. For advanced users who know the OBS WebSocket command list.

fields.connection: Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS.
fields.requestData: Extra details for the command, written as a JSON object. Leave empty if it needs none.
fields.resultArgument: The name of the variable that will hold the answer, so later steps can use it as %name%. Leave empty to not keep it. It will hold OBS's answer as text. The default is obsResult.

variables.obsResult: OBS's answer as JSON text (or the name you chose above)

obs.rawBatch.description: Sends OBS several commands of your own in one go and keeps the answers. For advanced users.

fields.connection: Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS.
fields.requests: A list of commands written as JSON, like [{"requestType":"GetVersion"}].
fields.haltOnFailure: Tick to stop at the first command that fails. Untick to keep going.
fields.resultArgument: The name of the variable that will hold the answer, so later steps can use it as %name%. Leave empty to not keep it. It will hold all the answers as text. The default is obsResult.
fields.executionType: SerialRealtime runs them one after the other. SerialFrame keeps them in step with OBS's video frames, so moves land in the same frame. Parallel runs them all at once, in any order.

variables.obsResult: All of OBS's answers as JSON text (or the name you chose above)

obs.sendCustomEvent.description: Sends your own message through OBS to every program connected to its WebSocket server, like overlays that use obs-websocket-js. Cuebot gets it back too.

fields.connection: Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS.
fields.eventData: The message as a JSON object, like {"type":"alert","user":"%user%"}.

obs.callVendorRequest.description: Asks an OBS plugin to do something through OBS's WebSocket server, for plugins that offer this (check the plugin's own help). For advanced users.

fields.connection: Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS.
fields.vendor: The name the plugin uses for its requests, from the plugin's help.
fields.requestType: The request name, from the plugin's help.
fields.requestData: Extra details for the request, written as a JSON object. Leave empty if it needs none.
fields.resultArgument: The name of the variable that will hold the plugin's answer as JSON text. Leave empty to not keep it. The default is obsVendorResult.

variables.obsVendorResult: The plugin's answer as JSON text (or the name you chose above)

obs.splitRecording.description: Starts a new recording file right now without stopping the recording. Handy for one file per segment. Needs OBS 30.2 or newer.

fields.connection: Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS.

obs.getRecordDirectory.description: Finds out which folder OBS saves recordings to.

fields.connection: Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS.
fields.resultArgument: The name of the variable that will hold the folder. Leave empty to not keep it. The default is obsRecordDirectory.

variables.obsRecordDirectory: The recording folder (or the name you chose above)

obs.setRecordDirectory.description: Changes the folder OBS saves recordings to, for example one folder per episode. Needs OBS 30 or newer.

fields.connection: Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS.
fields.directory: The folder as a full path on the OBS computer, like "D:\Videos\Episode 12".

obs.setAudioMonitor.description: Chooses whether you hear an audio source in your headphones: great for alerts only you should hear.

fields.connection: Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS.
fields.input: The audio source exactly as OBS shows it, like "Music" or "Mic/Aux".
fields.monitorType: None: you do not hear it. MonitorOnly: only you hear it (not the stream). MonitorAndOutput: you and the stream hear it.

obs.setAudioBalance.description: Moves an audio source to the left or right speaker.

fields.connection: Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS.
fields.input: The audio source exactly as OBS shows it, like "Music" or "Mic/Aux".
fields.balance: 0 is all left, 0.5 the middle, 1 all right.

obs.setAudioSyncOffset.description: Delays an audio source so it matches the video, in milliseconds.

fields.connection: Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS.
fields.input: The audio source exactly as OBS shows it, like "Music" or "Mic/Aux".
fields.milliseconds: The delay in milliseconds, from -950 to 20000. 0 is no delay.

obs.getAudioSettings.description: Reads every audio setting of a source at once: mute, volume, balance, delay, monitoring and tracks.

fields.connection: Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS.
fields.input: The audio source exactly as OBS shows it, like "Music" or "Mic/Aux".

variables.obsAudioTracks: Which tracks are on, as JSON text

obs.setSourceOrder.description: Moves a source in front of or behind the others in its scene.

fields.connection: Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS.
fields.scene: The scene, exactly as OBS shows it.
fields.source: The source, exactly as OBS shows it, like "Webcam".
fields.order: Top puts it in front of everything, Bottom behind everything, Up and Down move it one step, Position puts it at the number below.
fields.position: Only for Position: 0 is the very bottom (behind everything).

variables.obsSourceIndex: Its new position (0 is the bottom)

obs.setSourceLocked.description: Locks or unlocks a source in a scene, so it cannot be moved by accident.

fields.connection: Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS.
fields.scene: The scene, exactly as OBS shows it.
fields.source: The source, exactly as OBS shows it, like "Webcam".
fields.state: Lock, Unlock, or Toggle to flip it.

obs.setBlendMode.description: Changes how a source mixes with what is behind it, like Screen or Multiply.

fields.connection: Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS.
fields.scene: The scene, exactly as OBS shows it.
fields.source: The source, exactly as OBS shows it, like "Webcam".
fields.blendMode: Normal, Additive, Subtract, Screen, Multiply, Lighten or Darken.

obs.createInput.description: Creates a brand new source in a scene, like a browser source for a viewer card. Delete it again with Delete source.

fields.connection: Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS.
fields.scene: The scene to put it in, exactly as OBS shows it.
fields.name: The name for the new source. It must not be used yet.
fields.kind: The kind of source, like "browser_source", "image_source" or "color_source_v3". The list shows what your OBS offers.
fields.settings: Its settings as a JSON object, like {"url":"https://example.com"}. Leave empty for the defaults.
fields.visible: Tick to show it right away.
fields.resultArgument: The name of the variable that will hold its number in the scene. Leave empty to not keep it. The default is obsSceneItemId.

variables.obsSceneItemId: The number OBS gave it in the scene

obs.removeInput.description: Deletes a source from OBS and from every scene it is in. This cannot be undone.

fields.connection: Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS.
fields.input: The source to delete, exactly as OBS shows it.

obs.renameInput.description: Gives a source a new name.

fields.connection: Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS.
fields.input: The source to rename, exactly as OBS shows it.

obs.addSceneItem.description: Adds a source (or a scene) that already exists to a scene.

fields.connection: Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS.
fields.scene: The scene to add it to.
fields.source: The source or scene to add, exactly as OBS shows it.
fields.visible: Tick to show it right away.
fields.resultArgument: The name of the variable that will hold its number in the scene. Leave empty to not keep it. The default is obsSceneItemId.

variables.obsSceneItemId: The number OBS gave it in the scene

obs.removeSceneItem.description: Takes a source out of one scene. The source itself stays in OBS.

fields.connection: Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS.
fields.scene: The scene, exactly as OBS shows it.
fields.source: The source, exactly as OBS shows it, like "Webcam".

obs.duplicateSceneItem.description: Copies a source in a scene, with its position and crop, into the same or another scene.

fields.connection: Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS.
fields.scene: The scene the source is in.
fields.source: The source, exactly as OBS shows it, like "Webcam".
fields.destinationScene: The scene to put the copy in. Leave empty for the same scene.
fields.resultArgument: The name of the variable that will hold the copy's number. Leave empty to not keep it. The default is obsSceneItemId.

variables.obsSceneItemId: The number OBS gave the copy

obs.getSourceActive.description: Checks whether a source or scene is on your stream right now, and whether it shows anywhere in OBS.

fields.connection: Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS.
fields.source: The source or scene, exactly as OBS shows it.

variables.obsSourceActive: True when it is on the live output
variables.obsSourceShowing: True when it shows anywhere (live, preview, projector)

fields.connection: Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS.
fields.name: The name for the new scene.

obs.removeScene.description: Deletes a scene from OBS. This cannot be undone.

fields.connection: Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS.
fields.scene: The scene to delete, exactly as OBS shows it.

obs.renameScene.description: Gives a scene a new name.

fields.connection: Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS.
fields.scene: The scene to rename.

obs.setSceneTransitionOverride.description: Makes a scene always use a certain transition, like a 2 second fade into BRB.

fields.connection: Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS.
fields.scene: The scene, exactly as OBS shows it.
fields.transition: The transition to always use for this scene. Leave empty to remove the override.
fields.milliseconds: How long it takes, 50 to 20000 milliseconds. Leave empty to remove.

obs.createFilter.description: Adds a new filter to a source or scene.

fields.connection: Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS.
fields.source: The source or scene the filter is on, exactly as OBS shows it.
fields.filter: The name for the new filter.
fields.kind: The kind of filter, like "color_filter_v2". The list shows what your OBS offers (OBS 30.1+).
fields.settings: Its settings as a JSON object. Leave empty for the defaults.

obs.removeFilter.description: Removes a filter from a source or scene.

fields.connection: Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS.
fields.source: The source or scene the filter is on, exactly as OBS shows it.
fields.filter: The filter name exactly as OBS shows it.

obs.renameFilter.description: Gives a filter a new name.

fields.connection: Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS.
fields.source: The source or scene the filter is on, exactly as OBS shows it.
fields.filter: The filter name exactly as OBS shows it.

obs.setFilterOrder.description: Moves a filter up or down in the filter list of a source.

fields.connection: Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS.
fields.source: The source or scene the filter is on, exactly as OBS shows it.
fields.filter: The filter name exactly as OBS shows it.
fields.position: 0 is the first filter in the list.

obs.setTransitionSettings.description: Changes the settings of the current transition, like a stinger's video file. For advanced users.

fields.connection: Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS.
fields.settings: The settings as a JSON object.
fields.overlay: Tick to change only these settings; untick to replace all of them.

obs.getCurrentTransition.description: Reads the current transition: its name, kind, length and settings.

fields.connection: Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS.

variables.obsTransitionCursor: How far a running transition is, 0 to 1

obs.setTBar.description: Moves the studio mode T-bar, like dragging it with the mouse. OBS plans to replace this.

fields.connection: Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS.
fields.release: Tick to let go of the T-bar, so OBS finishes or cancels the transition.

obs.screenshotToVariable.description: Takes a picture of a source or scene and keeps it in a variable (as a data: link) instead of saving a file. Good for sending it to Discord.

fields.connection: Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS.
fields.source: The source or scene to photograph. Leave empty for the scene that is live now.
fields.format: The picture type: png, jpg, webp or bmp.
fields.width: Picture width in pixels, 8 to 4096. Leave empty for the normal size.
fields.height: Picture height in pixels, 8 to 4096. Leave empty for the normal size.
fields.quality: Picture quality from 0 to 100. Use -1 to let OBS decide.
fields.resultArgument: The name of the variable that will hold the picture. Leave empty to not keep it. The default is obsScreenshot.

variables.obsScreenshot: The picture as a data: link (or the name you chose above)

obs.sendCaption.description: Sends caption text with your stream, for viewers who turn captions on. Only works while you stream.

fields.connection: Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS.
fields.text: The caption text, like what you just said.

obs.openProjector.description: Opens a fullscreen projector of your program, preview, multiview or one source on a monitor of the OBS computer.

fields.connection: Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS.
fields.projector: Program, Preview, Multiview, or Source for one source.
fields.source: Only for Source: the source or scene to show.
fields.monitor: 0 is the first monitor, 1 the second. -1 opens a window instead.

obs.openSourceDialog.description: Opens the properties, filters or interact window of a source on the OBS computer, for a quick fix from a deck.

fields.connection: Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS.
fields.input: The source, exactly as OBS shows it.
fields.dialog: Properties, Filters, or Interact (for browser sources).

obs.triggerHotkeyKeys.description: Presses a key combination inside OBS, as if you pressed an OBS hotkey on the keyboard.

fields.connection: Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS.
fields.key: The OBS key name, like "OBS_KEY_F13" or "OBS_KEY_NUM1".

obs.setPersistentData.description: Saves a value inside OBS that stays after a restart and that other OBS tools can read.

fields.connection: Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS.
fields.realm: Global keeps it for every profile, Profile only for the current OBS profile.
fields.slot: A name for the value, like "deaths".
fields.value: The value: text, a number, or JSON.

obs.getPersistentData.description: Reads a value saved inside OBS.

fields.connection: Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS.
fields.realm: Global or Profile, where it was saved.
fields.resultArgument: The name of the variable that will hold the value. Leave empty to not keep it. The default is obsValue.

variables.obsValue: The saved value (empty if nothing is saved)

obs.createProfile.description: Creates a new OBS profile and switches to it.

fields.connection: Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS.
fields.profile: The name for the new profile.

obs.removeProfile.description: Deletes an OBS profile. This cannot be undone.

fields.connection: Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS.

obs.createSceneCollection.description: Creates a new, empty scene collection and switches to it. Can take a while.

fields.connection: Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS.
fields.sceneCollection: The name for the new scene collection.

obs.getProfileParameter.description: Reads one setting of the current OBS profile, by its section and name in the profile file. For advanced users.

fields.connection: Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS.
fields.name: The setting name, like "Mode".
fields.resultArgument: The name of the variable that will hold the value. Leave empty to not keep it. The default is obsProfileValue.

variables.obsProfileValue: The setting's value (empty if not set)

obs.setProfileParameter.description: Changes one setting of the current OBS profile. For advanced users: a wrong value can break the profile.

fields.connection: Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS.
fields.name: The setting name, like "Mode".
fields.value: The new value. Leave empty to delete the setting.

obs.getVideoSettings.description: Reads the canvas size, output size and frame rate.

fields.connection: Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS.

obs.setVideoSettings.description: Changes the canvas size, output size or frame rate. OBS refuses while streaming or recording.

fields.connection: Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS.
fields.baseWidth: Canvas width in pixels. Give the height too, or leave both empty.
fields.outputWidth: Output (scaled) width in pixels. Give the height too, or leave both empty.
fields.fpsNumerator: Frames per second, like 60. Leave empty to keep.

obs.getStreamService.description: Reads where OBS streams to. The stream key is hidden, so it never shows up in your variables.

fields.connection: Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS.

variables.obsStreamService: All settings as JSON text, with the key hidden

obs.setStreamService.description: Changes where OBS streams to, including the stream key. Treat this step like a password: never share actions that contain your key.

fields.connection: Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS.
fields.serviceType: rtmp_custom for your own server, rtmp_common for a listed service.
fields.settings: The settings as a JSON object, like {"server":"rtmp://...","key":"..."}.

obs.output.description: Starts, stops or toggles one OBS output by name, like the extra stream of a plugin.

fields.connection: Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS.
fields.output: The output name. The list shows what your OBS has.

obs.getOutputSettings.description: Reads the settings of one OBS output. Stream keys are hidden.

fields.connection: Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS.
fields.resultArgument: The name of the variable that will hold the settings. Leave empty to not keep it. The default is obsOutputSettings.

variables.obsOutputSettings: The settings as JSON text (or the name you chose above)

obs.setOutputSettings.description: Changes the settings of one OBS output. For advanced users.

fields.connection: Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS.
fields.settings: The settings as a JSON object.

obs.getSpecialInputs.description: Finds the names of OBS's global audio sources: desktop audio and microphones.

fields.connection: Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS.

obs.getInputListItems.description: Lists the choices of a list in a source's settings, like the displays of a display capture.

fields.connection: Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS.
fields.input: The source, exactly as OBS shows it.
fields.resultArgument: The name of the variable that will hold the list. Leave empty to not keep it. The default is obsListItems.

variables.obsListItems: The choices as JSON text (itemName, itemValue, itemEnabled)

obs.setDeinterlace.description: Changes deinterlacing of a video source like a capture card. Needs OBS 31.1 or newer.

fields.connection: Which OBS to use, if you connected more than one. Type its name from your OBS settings in Cuebot. Leave empty to use your main OBS.
fields.input: The video source, exactly as OBS shows it.
fields.mode: The deinterlacing mode, or Keep to leave it.
fields.fieldOrder: Top or Bottom field first, or Keep to leave it.
